c04-compare.js: const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); await sleep(2500); [...document.querySelectorAll('.segmented button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Table')?.click(); await sleep(1200); const all = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.includes('Compare all')); if (all) { all.click(); await sleep(3000); } else { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr.result-row')].slice(0, 5); for (const r of rows) { r.querySelector('.tray-toggle')?.click(); await sleep(700); } [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Open the comparison')?.click(); await sleep(3000); } for (const b of [...document.querySelectorAll('.cmp button')].filter(b => /differ/i.test(b.innerText))) { b.click(); await sleep(800); } await sleep(1000); document.querySelectorAll('.cmp-scroll').forEach(e => e.style.maxHeight = 'none'); await sleep(500);
